scope: Capture extension only; no changes to recovery algorithm, PWM, ADC, motor protection or timed-stop policy
sample_schedule: Immediately after existing PE0 readback/DSB, then first actual main-loop observation at or after5us/20us; timestamps are actual observations, not guaranteed trigger instants
publication: Only with outputs OFF and fresh exact peer2706; incomplete or mixed records are not published; archived primary snapshots remain separate and frozen
classification: Observed HIGH/LOW/mixed/unknown after PE0; never claims which device caused LOW; missing or delayed samples remain explicit
preservation: 10 historical hardware records copied byte-for-byte with SHA256. Installer passively archives complete current RAM records before any firmware write and fails closed if incomplete. No CLEAR/START/reset in the archive step. A future firmware reset naturally starts new RAM records; prior captures remain in archived files.
programming: Both boards are currently detected; last read-only status10V SAFE/PWM0/ARM0. USB availability alone does not certify J1 isolated. Installation requires J1OFF and independent DMM<20V; 15V may remainON; wiring unchanged.
limitations: No powered trial was run in preparation
